purpose: Map dependencies between sources, records, facts, legal propositions, procedures and published answers so material changes can trigger targeted re-verification.
core_principle: ONE MATERIAL SOURCE CHANGE → IDENTIFY ALL DEPENDENT OBJECTS → REVERIFY ONLY WHAT IS AFFECTED.
dependency_rules: Every material answer component must identify its direct dependencies.
A dependency is material when changing it could change the answer, legal effect, procedure, deadline or publication state.
Source freshness changes propagate only through connected dependent nodes.
A historical answer remains anchored to its target date even when current records change.
A source change does not automatically invalidate unrelated answers.
Legal-source changes and property-record changes are propagated through separate dependency paths.
A superseded node remains in the graph for historical reconstruction.
hard_stops: Never assume every source change affects every answer.
Never silently invalidate an answer without recording the dependency path.
Never treat graph connectivity as proof of the underlying fact.
Never delete superseded dependency nodes needed for historical reconstruction.
Never publish a previously affected answer without the required re-verification.
